name: Hanniel
title: Clan Leader of Manasseh
summary: Hanniel, son of Ephod, was a leader from the tribe of Manasseh appointed by God to help distribute the land of Canaan among the tribes of Israel. He is mentioned among the tribal leaders responsible for allocating the inheritance west of the Jordan. Another Hanniel is mentioned as the son of Ulla from the tribe of Asher.

keyEvents.title: Appointed to Distribute the Land
keyEvents.description: God spoke to Moses and gave him the names of the men who were to distribute the land of Canaan as an inheritance among the tribes. Hanniel, son of Ephod, was chosen to represent the tribe of Manasseh.

keyEvents.title: Leaders for the Distribution of the Land Appointed
keyEvents.description: Together with Eleazar the priest and Joshua, Hanniel and the other tribal leaders were given authority to distribute the inherited land among the nine and a half tribes west of the Jordan.

keyEvents.title: Hanniel from the Tribe of Asher
keyEvents.description: Another man named Hanniel is mentioned as the son of Ulla, a descendant of the tribe of Asher, among the brave warriors and family heads in the tribal records of Israel.

keyEvents.title: Moses receives God's instructions on the distribution of the land
keyEvents.description: God instructed Moses on how the land of Canaan was to be distributed by casting lots, and appointed specific leaders from each tribe to carry out the distribution.
